description: List all available data sources with their coverage and supported filters. coverage is one of national (all US states), regional (a subset of states), state (one state), or county (one county). states lists the USPS codes covered; it is null for national feeds and for regional feeds whose footprint varies - query /v1/properties/data with the state filter to enumerate those.

Search across all data sources simultaneously. Paid retail requests return up to 100 rows total across all source groups; new trials return up to 10. Groups after the limit contain counts and empty records. At least one location filter (county, state, zip, or address) is required.

params.name: limit
params.description: Total listing rows across all groups: 1–100 paid or 1–10 during a new trial. Defaults to 25 when paid or 10 during a new trial. Choose a value within your remaining allowance.

params.name: mode
params.description: Use unified for one records array with consistent field names, including source, row_id, nullable owner_first_name / owner_last_name, and file_number where supplied. The default groups source-specific records by feed.

params.name: county
params.description: County name filter. Can specify multiple (e.g., county=Cook&county=Lake).

params.name: state
params.description: State name or abbreviation. Can specify multiple.

params.name: zip
params.description: Zip code filter. Can specify multiple.

params.name: address
params.description: Property address filter (partial match). Can specify multiple.

params.name: pre_foreclosure
params.description: Set true or 1 for scheduled-sale preforeclosures: sale date today or later (UTC), excluding REO-only feeds and REO asset types. Matches the dashboard filter. Listings without a known sale date, including early-stage defaults, are excluded. false or 0 disables the filter (default); other values return 400. A location filter is still required.

params.name: sale_date_start
params.description: Filter by sale date start (YYYY-MM-DD).

params.name: sale_date_end
params.description: Filter by sale date end (YYYY-MM-DD).

params.name: owner_name
params.description: Owner name filter (partial match on first or last name). Only applied to sources that expose owner fields.

params.name: est_value_min
params.description: Minimum estimated value (Market Valuation). Only applied to sources with an estimated value field.

params.name: est_value_max
params.description: Maximum estimated value (Market Valuation). Only applied to sources with an estimated value field.

import requests

res = requests.get(

    headers={"x-api-key": "fdh_ak_..."},

)
data = res.json()

description: Search with mode=unified to get normalized, paginated results across all sources in a single flat list. Each record includes standardized fields (address, city, state, zip, county, sale_date, bid_amount, owner name, etc.) with a source field indicating origin.

params.name: mode
params.description: Set to "unified" to enable unified mode.

params.name: county
params.description: County name filter. Can specify multiple.

params.name: state
params.description: State name or abbreviation. Can specify multiple.

params.name: zip
params.description: Zip code filter. Can specify multiple.

params.name: address
params.description: Property address filter (partial match). Can specify multiple.

params.name: pre_foreclosure
params.description: Set true or 1 for scheduled-sale preforeclosures: sale date today or later (UTC), excluding REO-only feeds and REO asset types. Matches the dashboard filter. Listings without a known sale date, including early-stage defaults, are excluded. false or 0 disables the filter (default); other values return 400. A location filter is still required.

params.name: sale_date_start
params.description: Filter by sale date start (YYYY-MM-DD).

params.name: sale_date_end
params.description: Filter by sale date end (YYYY-MM-DD).

params.name: sale_days
params.description: Minimum lead time: sale_date_parsed must be later than today + N days (integer 1-365, unbounded above). ANDs with sale_date_start/sale_date_end. Listings without a parsed sale date stay included — an unscheduled sale cannot violate the bound. Unified mode only.

params.name: sale_status
params.description: Canonical sale-status group: active, coming-soon, for-sale, postponed, cancelled, price-reduced, back-to-bank, new-listing, sold, mortgage-foreclosure, outbid, preview, pending, hard-to-sell, nos, vacant-lot, sale-held, none. Groups merge clearly-equivalent feed statuses — e.g. cancelled covers Cancelled/WITHDRAWN/Sale Invalid, sold covers Sold/Completed/3rd-party variants, postponed covers postpone*/On Hold. none matches listings with no reported status. Unified mode only.

params.name: owner_name
params.description: Owner name filter (partial match on first or last name).

params.name: est_value_min
params.description: Minimum estimated value (Market Valuation). Uses the unified zestimate_numeric column.

params.name: est_value_max
params.description: Maximum estimated value (Market Valuation). Uses the unified zestimate_numeric column.

params.name: page
params.description: Page number (default: 1).

params.name: page_size
params.description: Results per page, 1–100 for paid keys or 1–10 for new trials. Defaults to 25 paid or 10 during a trial. Your remaining allowance may lower an omitted first-page size.
